book.name: METIU
book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Jon Tobaptais wana Mate
He sauge yake, Herodi iye Galili wedi tologugui, i longe Yeisu wasane,
habeto i liwo wana tokaiwo heidiye i nga, “Ga yetei Jon Tobaptais, i suwoyukim he mate. Iye te kaiwane wana gaisi i gan ge pamali yauyawate i ginginawiid.”

Veto Herodi i hadaenge hwae Herodiyas, iye havane Filip poniyene. Jon i mimi lihulihu Herodi heine i nga, “Taine bosowaine u dehadaenge.” Iyete baene, Herodi i patileid wana tokaiwo-yan, bwen si bwange Jon si yawan ge si hotei he dibula.
Herodi nuwane i tagapamate, age i matokanid bobode, kaiwane si goru Jon heine iye profet hotiya.
Herodi wana hab yanine yariyaeine hei, Herodiyas natune vainiine i salisali he boda matadiye. Wana salisali Herodi i yariyae-yan suwok,
habeto i nga, “Tolosuwok a silo tamau, hebe sahe u hawanunan, bwele a giyau heim.”
Tinane i liwo heine, habeto iye i liwo Herodi heine i nga, “Jon Tobaptais dumuwone u gotem, kahulune u ho dohe he nohe, u ho luwom ge u giyau heyau gen a paidi.”
Kin nuwane i ngak, age i liwo si ginawi sohode vaini yake wana nuwotu, kaiwane hobak i silosilo hebwaden si la he sagae yake he matadiye.
Iyete i liwo ge Jon dumuwone si gotem he dibula.
Kahulune si ho dohe he nohe, habeto si ho luwom si giyau vaini yake heine ge i ho giyau tinane heine.
Bwen Jon wana topadavae si luwom, si howo tuwane ge si la si holem he haliwage, habeto si la si giyau Yeisu wana wase.
Yeisu I Pahanid Boda Paib Tausan
Yeisu i longe wase ya habe i seyok hiyebe yake, ge i sai he wage tage si la si emivevek he papaeli. Bobode si longe wana yogo wasane, bwen si seyokid habadiye ge si dodogan he hehediye si sedumuyai.
Sauge Yeisu i gaedau ge i paidiid boda, bwen hatiyene i dau kaiwadiye ge wedi tobolebole-yan i pamoluid.
Saugeine i kokoyavi suwok, wana topadavae si luwom heine si nga, “Hiyebe ya i mipabwagebwage ge hawesine ege bwen i gogou. Boda u patileid si la he yawan-yan ge si pamaise nahadiye.”
Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Tab si eyogo! Humiu hu giyau haga hotiya si han.”
Si liwo heine si nga, “Bred pwahi-lime ge yalogi ho-iwo ege te i gan heyai.”
Bwen i nga, “Gen hu yomo luwom heyau.”

Habeto i liwo bobode si tuwodau he nan pwapwatane, bwen i howo bred pwahi-lime ge yalogi bunim-iwo, matane i lisin he bulubulu ge i gomulolu Helak heine. Habeto bred i pieneene-yan, bwen i giyau wana topadavae heidiye ge sidiye habe si talaotan bobode heidiye.
Bobode hoyowate si han tine sus, habeto wedi han tuwoi topadavae si bagavetahe, hana yogowo nabwa-yawate nabwa-iwo (12).
Bobode henebwaden si hanhan hedi hohoyowate anamate paib tausan, agegene taine si dehowo venakau ge gamagai hedi hohoyowate.
Yeisu I Dodogan he Soge Pwatane
Habe Yeisu i liwo wana topadavae heidiye si sai he wage ge si dedei si hadopanek panhiyebe hotiya, habe iye i patileid bobode si yogo.
I patile mwaoid si yogo, habeto iye i totiya ege i la i tihe sai he bobokun ge i hauhawanun. Sauge i gogou i totaege i miye te he yake,
agegene wage hobak hana bwage i gan he hiyebe, bagod i tagapagigiyele-yan suwok, kaiwane didiyewo i towo pasanahad.
Henanai suwok tri oklok ge siks oklok he hauhawaline, habeto Yeisu i luwom heidiye i dodogon he soge pwatane.
Wana topadavae-yan si paidi i dodogan he soge pwatane hoge si matok si nga, “Balome ti ya!” Bwen si yale bwaine ge wedi matok.
Ge petaege Yeisu i liwo heidiye i nga, “Hatiyemiu i matuwo! Tab matok! Nau ti ya.”
Pita i nga, “Guyau, hebe tolosuwok huwo, u liwo heyau a dodogon he soge pwatane ge a lowo heim.”
Yeisu i golase halingane i nga, “U luwom.” Habeto Pita i sedau i dodogan he soge pwatane i la Yeisu heine.
Age saugeine i paidi rebu, bwen i matok ge i telipune i dobiyek, habe i gon i nga, “Guyau, u pamwadau!”
Petaege Yeisu nimane i pamwalao ge i pihasik, bwen i nga, “Lam goru taine i dekai! Sahe kaiwane u nuwo veveiwo?”
Sauge si gaesai he wage, bwen didiyewo i mate.
Habeto henebwaden si miyemiye he wage si kululu heine si nga, “Tolosuwok, huwo Helak Natune.”
Si hadopanek si la si tan he hiyebe Genesaret.
Sauge bobode si paidi Yeisu si lapu iye ti yo, bwen si patile wase he yawanine bwabwaligane ge si yomo luwomid tobolebole hoyowate.
Habeto si hawanun heine wedi tobolebole si pihasik ege hana kaliko busune, ge hebwaden si pinohon, bwabwaligadiye si molu.
